run_catch_exceptions_tests: run the googletest catch exceptions test suite to verify C++ and SEH exception handling
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_fixture_cons: test that C++ exceptions thrown in a test fixture constructor are caught and logged correctly
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_setup_teardo: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUp or TearDown are caught and remaining teardown still runs
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_test_body: test that C++ exceptions thrown in the test body are caught and TearDown still executes
test_CatchSehExceptionsTest_seh_handling: test that SEH exceptions with code 0x2a are caught across all fixture lifecycle stages
